checks.name: Compact cinematic timing replaces the 20.8s awards

Props are painted at the solved hand, never floating away from it

Whip-pan replaces the black dip at every award boundary
Same time ⇒ same scene and same paint, regardless of seek order or cache
Particles are analytic, capped and never use Math.random or Race.rng
Ceremony is a read-only consumer of the frozen record
